verses.note: Lot chose land by what his eyes saw (13:10), and the wealth he gathered there is the first thing he loses. The verse shows, without comment, how exposed a life becomes when its choices are made for gain.
Abram's tenth is the Bible's first tithe, given freely before any law required it. It is a confession that the spoils came from God; Jacob will make a similar vow in 28:22.
